_comment: Mutation testing — LOCAL pre-release audit, not CI (GitHub Actions are too slow for this; run `npm run mutation`). perTest coverage analysis means each mutant only runs the tests that cover it; incremental mode caches results so re-runs after small changes take seconds-to-minutes. The mutate list is the pure logic the unit suite exercises — plugin bootstrap, settings UI, and the DOM-bound popup are smoke-test territory where mutants would just be no-coverage noise.
